decisions.minimumMissingWitness: Bind/authorize the operational Astral site and projection/body/resource/return contract, then demonstrate a legally acquired rank9 caster with multiple distinct willing companions actually arriving and acting, followed by independent companion return after real movement and item/component use while others continue. Include original-body movement/confinement/loss, actual ward predicates, injury/Null, suppression, return-fit conflict and conserved clocks/custody.
requiredContent: An authorized operational Astral destination/site record with actual arrival selection, body-fit geometry, support/environment, legal useful movement/action and applicable endpoint restrictions. Printed Astral names and teachings do not specify those measurements or travel permissions.

An explicit projection relation: whether and where original bodies remain, projected anatomy/geometry/capabilities, awareness/control, one actor schedule and conserved HP/resources/conditions, gear/components/loot/passenger allocation. No second body, soul or inventory is assumed.

A complete Instantaneous-initiation/continuing-result lifecycle: duration/concentration choice, individual return and cohort persistence, source loci, elapsed/outside clocks, injury/0HP/Null classification, original-body movement/loss/death, suppression/dispel, replacement and finite return conflict/custody settlement.

decisions.minimumMissingWitness: Bind/authorize at least two complete entombment methods and their physical/magical profiles; demonstrate a paid legal cast on a defended creature, actual failed resistance/admission, each selected mode positively, and useful lawful escape or outside rescue with full budgets, needs/clocks, growth, suppression/resumption, corpse/gear and competing-source branches.
requiredContent: An authorized finite menu of at least two meaningful entombment methods, with exact creature eligibility/resistance and each method's actual body-fit shape/location/material or magical boundary; no method, dimensions, AC/HP or burial depth is supplied by the native card.

Each mode's Instantaneous versus persistent-result lifecycle, needs/awareness/agency, physical/magical escape and external rescue with actual costs, barriers/tools/checks and source-owned release conditions.
Complete mode-specific growth/attachment/partial-suppression/resumption-collision/death/corpse/gear/recast and competing-source outcomes, with durable ownership and once-only terminal settlement.
